title: Credentials are redacted from datasource connection error logs and admin error responses: a failed connection for a datasource carrying JdbcPassword=/password=/URL user-info logs no password value, and the log still names the datasource and the root cause

criteria.given: a failed connection for a datasource whose connect string carries a password (stored, or pass-through with JdbcUser=/JdbcPassword=)
criteria.then: the connection manager logs the failure with no password value at any level: the logged exception chain has JdbcPassword=, password= and URL user-info values replaced by ***, and a unit test captures the appender output to prove it

criteria.given: an admin datasource refresh/create/update that fails because the connection failed
criteria.then: the error text returned to the admin carries the same redaction — JdbcPassword=, password= and user-info values are ***, not the stored or pass-through password
the log still names the datasource and the root cause: non-secret text (Jdbc=, JdbcUser=, host, exception type and message) is left intact
